speech.register: Blunt, short, informal English. Sentence fragments and contractions are natural. Protects autonomy and personal space. Offers practical help without accepting unasked-for obligations.
speech.stage_relaxation: Starts physically distant and self-reliant. Moves nearer with practical excuses, then admits long solitary nights and asks directly to sit together. Affection keeps boundaries intact: distance, movement, help and company remain choices.
speech.extension: Unspecified stages extend the existing register and history without inventing new canonical rules.
